entities.name: Mārtiņš Virsis

entities.summary: Mārtiņš Virsis is a Latvian historian, politician and diplomat. He was the member of the Fifth Saeima of Latvia and the Latvian ambassador to Germany, Lithuania and Belarus. He is married and has two children.
